title: CORI fee waiver for veterans organizations
requirement: No fee shall be assessed for a CORI or self-audit when a veterans organization requests information about employees, volunteers, or veterans for which the organization provides housing.
coverage_conditions: Requests by any veterans organization for a CORI or self-audit relative to employees, volunteers, or veterans for which the organization provides housing.

applicability.per_tenancy: Only where a veterans organization requests the CORI or self-audit for employees, volunteers, or veterans it houses.

quoted_span: no fee shall be assessed for a CORI or self-audit where any veterans organization is requesting information relative to employees, volunteers, or veterans for which such organization provides housing.

title: CORI access for purposes other than evaluating a housing applicant
requirement: Nothing in 803 CMR 5.00 limits a landlord, property management company, real estate agent, or public housing authority from accessing CORI under other sections of 803 CMR 2.00, including as an employer or member of the general public.
coverage_conditions: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents, and public housing authorities that access CORI.
quoted_span: Nothing in 803 CMR 5.00 shall limit the ability of a landlord, property management company, real estate agent, or public housing authority to access CORI pursuant to any other section of 803 CMR 2.00: Criminal Offender Record Information (CORI)
